Select high-grade Iron Ore, black as lacquer and solid in texture.
Pound it with a water-powered trip hammer, then grind with a stone roller.
After one day, grains resemble rice; after two days, millet; after three days, powder as fine as flour.

Sift it—retain the finest particles, while re-grinding the coarse ones for uniformity.
